 It wasn't far away.

 Just over 10 minutes to go as Anthony Gordon drives forward and lays off for Morgan Rogers.

 Spain dominating possession, as you would have expected them to before the match.

 The ref is having too much of an impact in the game. Several non fouls given interrupting what could be a good game.
 Mike Harris

 Spain 0-0 England 
 Things have certainly settled inside the Metropolitano. On the field, anyway.
 Spain try the ball in behind but Mikel Oyarzabal has drifted offside.

 Spain 0-0 England 
 Fabian Ruiz sends a good-looking ball into the box but it's cleared, it drops for Pedro Porro but he blazes his effort over the bar.

 Post published at 20:14 GMT 20:14 GMT 
 Spain 0-0 England 
 Matt Upson 
Ex-England defender on BBC Radio 5 Live in Madrid 
 It wasn't the best of touches from Bellingham. I think he's onside, if that goes to review I think he's on. It was a brilliant touch from Kane.

 get involved Get Involved published at 20:14 GMT 20:14 GMT

 Spain are both brilliant and frustrating to watch - their constant play acting isn’t attractive but seems part of their game. The great Barca teams were brilliant at the dark arts!
 KF 
 553 216 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 24 mins 24 mins 
 Spain 0-0 England 
 After a really bright start, England's tempo has just dropped off a little.
 Spain enjoy a decent period of possession before Jude Bellingham fires into the side netting but is pulled back for offside.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 90 58 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:11 GMT 20:11 GMT 
 Spain 0-0 England 
 Matt Upson 
Ex-England defender on BBC Radio 5 Live in Madrid 
 If you're going to give it as a foul for me you can only give it if there's enough contact for a yellow card. The referee knows there's barely any contact.
 329 94 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21 mins 21 mins 
 Spain 0-0 England 
 A bit of a battle developing between Lewis Hall and Lamine Yamal and, after a bit of thinking about it, the referee awards Spain a free-kick as Hall is deemed to have had hold of Yamal.
 A harsh one.
 148 461 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 England fans serenading Kane published at 20:09 GMT 20:09 GMT 
 Spain 0-0 England 
 Phil McNulty 
BBC Sport chief football writer in Madrid 
 England's fans are singing "Harry Kane, The Best In The World" after his Ballon d'Or win - followed by "Where's Your Ballon d'Or" after Lamine Yamal, who finished third, wins a free-kick.
 It's hit the spot as both are met with jeers from the Spain fans.
 442 109 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 21 mins 21 mins 
 Spain 0-0 England 
 Spain are forced into an early change.
 Marc Pubill makes way for Pedro Porro. Did Pubill pick up an injury at one of the set pieces?

 Matt Upson 
Ex-England defender on BBC Radio 5 Live in Madrid 
 It was that good a run I thought Lewis Hall was Anthony Gordon! It was so decisive. It mirrored the start of this game for England, they've been aggressive and really taken the game to Spain.
